title: Simulation Expansion and Contraction
summary: Move low- or high-disruption components between surrounding and simulated sets to see why thesis-derived constructive spiking algorithms treat growth as careful simulation expansion.
learning_goals: Distinguish construction/pruning in memory from expansion/contraction of the simulated set.
Explain why low-disruption additions are more biologically plausible in spiking simulations.
Connect simulation expansion to later STDP-based parameter calculation for constructed synapses.
